meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取和回复 GitHub 仓库的 Pull Request 和 Issue 评论。当有人在评论中 @ 你的机器人账号时，Claude 会自动参与对话。
howto.when: 当有人在已配置的 GitHub 仓库的 PR 或 Issue 评论中 @ 你的机器人账号时触发。首次 @ 后，该线程会被订阅，后续所有评论都会触发。

say.text: 帮我回复这个 PR 评论：@my-org-bot 这个方案可行吗？
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 的上下文并生成回复。

say.text: 检查这个 Issue 的讨论，总结一下大家的意见。
say.note: Claude 会读取 Issue 评论并给出总结。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read and reply to GitHub Pull Request and Issue comment threads. When someone @-mentions your bot account in a comment, Claude automatically joins the conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions your bot account in a PR or Issue comment on a configured GitHub repo. After the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all subsequent comments trigger a response.

say_en.text: Help me reply to this PR comment: @my-org-bot Is this approach feasible?
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR context and generates a reply.

say_en.text: Review the discussion in this Issue and summarize everyone's opinions.
say_en.note: Claude reads the Issue comments and provides a summary.
